newsitem.title: SHARJAH: CRICKET-DE SILVA, ATAPATTU LEAD SRI LANKA TO VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-DE SILVA, ATAPATTU LEAD SRI LANKA TO VICTORY.

text.p: Scintillating batting from Aravinda de Silva and Marvan Atapattu lifted Sri Lanka to a 19-run win over Pakistan on Friday, their second successive victory in the Sharjah Cup.
The pair put on 184 off 233 balls for the third wicket as Sri Lanka recovered from a stuttering start to post a challenging 243 for eight in their allotted 50 overs.
Pakistan, in reply, looked to be cruising home at 173 for four in the 38th over before a dramatic collapse saw them lose five wickets for 24 runs, including two run outs.

Shahid Afridi, living a charmed life, blasted a fluent 67 off 55 balls with four sixes and five fours while Salim Malik weighed in with 51 off 64 balls. But they blew the advantage in the end, assisted by a good spell from Muttiah Muralitharan who took three wickets for 38 runs.

Earlier Aravinda, playing his 200th international, cracked a stroke-filled 97 off 137 balls with six fours while Atapattu justified his selection as a number three batsman with 94 off 118 balls with 10 fours.
Sri Lanka, 222 for four in 45.2 overs, lost five wickets for just 21 runs in ther remaining overs, all their batsmen falling to adventurous shots.
Off spinner Saqlain Mushtaq did most of the damage, returning figures of three for 47.
